$schema: families: one entry per family of mods that does one job. `mods` and `addons` are keyed by `<minecraft>/<loader>` and hold mods.txt lines (full mods.txt syntax). Families in one `group` do the same job; the highest priority wins. See docs/catalog.md.

tags.storage: digital or bulk storage, pipes, logistics
tags.combat: how fighting feels: combos, dodges, new weapons
tags.mobs: new creatures, dragons, villagers that matter
tags.quests: a quest book that leads the player
tags.qol: recipes viewer, tooltips, inventory sorting, backpacks, small conveniences
tags.balance: one ingot per metal across mods, conflicting recipes resolved
tags.tune: lets the pack author change recipes and add items
